verdict.rationale: Smithery provides per-server pages for discovery ('dedicated server page where users can discover, try, and install'), CLI search/tool-find commands, and typed SDKs generated from each server's tool/trigger schemas, implying tool and schema visibility before connecting. However, there is no explicit documentation showing a UI/API that surfaces transport type or hosting attributes (e.g., remote/local, uplink vs. hosted) prior to connection—these are only inferable from separate docs pages (uplink, publish) rather than a unified inspection view. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a pre-connection view showing transport type and hosting attributes together, and independent/hands-on confirmation that schema/tool inspection works as described.
